name: C7-A only: online activation detection and candidate transfer-mechanism identification
source: positive unknown-amplitude step at10 in simulator; source event, not change of transfer parameters
sensor_timing: sensor at t_j accompanies X_j, t_j=.05,.10,...; never the next sensor sample
source_and_transfer: same C6 generators and physical units; main four classes all share step source; separate genuinely passive-equivalent causal pair
training: independent healthy-X AR, unlabelled pooled X amplitude-prior learning, healthy sensor variance estimation; no true Y/U/kappa/onset/class labels to inference
online_method: new candidate-library Gaussian GLR for change gate plus proper half-normal amplitude and onset/scale-marginal posterior for identification; not original M3
candidate_library: C6 same21 scale grid,79 onset grid; at each clock only origins<=clock-.25 eligible
alarm: first2 consecutive calibrated GLR crossings; never reset at true event
identification: first same-class posterior>=.8 for2 consecutive updates ending on/after gate alarm, then irrevocable commit; no truth-driven retry
first_correct: retrospective oracle diagnostic only, distinct from first operational commit and not advertised as algorithm output

calibration.method: binomial order-statistic tolerance threshold, simultaneous95% confidence over21 main/binary-channel/noise/reference cells

primary: paired event-detection and correct-first-commit coverage at time12 (2 after event), sensor-U vsX andsensor-Y vsX:4 contrasts
inference_rule: Bonferroni4 paired stratified cluster98.75% bootstrap intervals,5percentage-point practical reference, both cohorts positive
independent_unit: noise/cohort/trajectory, average4 classes and4 lag groups first;600 independent paired blocks
warning_reference: healthy AR1-unit matured prediction errors, latest4 updates,2-crossing tolerance-calibrated whole trajectory; not physical failure ground truth
cost: channel count0 extra vs1 extra; same sensor sampling/noise, no financial-cost claim
limitations: low-noise sensor only; not arbitrary sensor quality
source activation does not establish changing causal edge detection
no original-M3 superiority comparison in C7-A
